## Summary

Provide a short summary of the changes in this PR.

## Changelog entry (if applicable)

If this project maintains a changelog, add a single-line entry under the `Unreleased` section and paste it here.
Recommended format: `- [Added|Changed|Fixed] Short description. (PR #123 / JIRA-123)`

Example:

- Added: Add `tls_cert_path` variable to allow custom certificate locations. (JIRA-123, PR #42)

## Related issues / PRs

- Link to issue(s) or PR(s) this change addresses.
